shortDescription: Information module for Images Site Wise Product Names Count

options.name: assigned
options.description: Assigned query parameter. Filter with the assigned/unassigned, `ASSIGNED` option will filter network device products that are associated with the given image. The `NOT_ASSIGNED` option will filter network device products that have not yet been associated with the given image but apply to it. Available values ASSIGNED, NOT_ASSIGNED.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: imageId
options.description: ImageId path parameter. Software image identifier. Refer `/dna/intent/api/v/images` API for obtaining `imageId`.

options.name: productId
options.description: ProductId query parameter. Filter with product ID (PID).

options.name: productName
options.description: ProductName query parameter. Filter with network device product name. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters are required for search.

options.name: recommended
options.description: Recommended query parameter. Filter with recommended source. If `CISCO` then the network device product assigned was recommended by Cisco and `USER` then the user has manually assigned. Available values CISCO, USER.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
